$comment: What each board house asks for in an order, read from its own help pages on the date given. `source` lists the pages. Where a page names a field but not the exact heading, `notes` says so: check the house's sample file before changing a heading, and update `checked`. File names use the Protel extensions (GTL, GBL, GTS, GBS, GTP, GBP, GTO, GBO, GKO), which neither house's page asks for by name but both read.

houses.name: JLCPCB
notes: BOM: a .csv, .xls or .xlsx file with at least Comment, Designator, Footprint and the JLCPCB or LCSC part number.
Pick and place: Designator, Mid X, Mid Y, Layer (Top or Bottom) and Rotation, in millimetres. Positive rotation is anticlockwise.
The pages do not say where coordinates are measured from, or how bottom parts are turned. JLCPCB shows the placement for you to check before you pay: check it there.
The part number heading is not fixed on the pages ("JLCPCB / LCSC Part #"); "LCSC Part #" is the one their KiCad guide shows.

houses.name: PCBWay
notes: Gerbers in RS-274X, with at least silkscreen, copper and solder paste layers for assembly.

BOM: .xls, .xlsx or .csv with line number, quantity, reference designator, part number, description, package and type (surface mount, thru-hole or hybrid). Turn-key orders add manufacturer, manufacturer part number and distributor part number.
Centroid: reference designator, X and Y, rotation and side (Top or Bottom), surface mount parts only.
The page names these fields but gives no exact headings, units or rotation rule: the headings here are the page's field names.

houses.name: Any board house
notes: Plain names and every column. Positions are in millimetres from the board's origin, the same as the Gerbers; rotation is anticlockwise seen from the top.
